title: List and release leased license files
summary: Shows how to read the current licenses with ILicenseManager, find the installation's security folder and its .alf files, and release leased licenses and switch to standalone behind a Confirm=true dry-run guard.
phrasings: give back a leased Altium license
find the .alf license files of an installation
switch Altium Designer to a standalone license
list the current license ids and names

commands.name: ListLicenseFiles
commands.description: List the current licences and the .alf files in the security folder
commands.params: [SecurityFolder=<folder with *.alf files; default: derived from the running installation>]

commands.name: ReleaseLicense
commands.description: Release the leased licences (dry run unless Confirm is set)
